notes.text: Selector lists, descendant, child, adjacent-sibling, and general-sibling combinators, supported attribute and functional pseudo-class selectors, specificity, and source-order ties are covered by browser parity fixtures.
Pseudo-elements and most pseudo-classes are not implemented.
Unsupported CSS and selectors are ignored with one actionable warning per distinct input by default; strict throw and silent ignore policies remain configurable.
